No—I can't browse the web in real time. My knowledge is current only up to **June 2024**, and I don’t have the ability to access live websites, search engines, or up-to-date information beyond that cutoff.

However, I can:
- Summarize or analyze information from my training data (up to June 2024).
- Help with research, writing, or problem-solving based on that data.
- Guide you on how to find the latest information yourself (e.g., using search engines, news sites, or tools like Google Scholar).

If you need **real-time data** (e.g., news, stock prices, or recent events), I recommend checking reliable sources like:
- **News**: [BBC](https://www.bbc.com), [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com), [AP News](https://apnews.com)
- **Search**: [Google](https://www.google.com), [DuckDuckGo](https://duckduckgo.com)
- **Academic**: [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com)
